self_report: Understands a lot of Russian and knows many words passively, learned mostly by ear. Has rarely written Russian and spells words the way he pronounces them. Struggles with grammar (endings, cases) and with expressing himself in speaking and writing.
goals: Speak and write Russian accurately and with confidence
Control case endings and verb aspect in real sentences
Close the gap between what he understands and what he can say

overall.note: Placement in progress: grammar test done (2026-11-08). Writing, speaking and reading samples still to come before levels are set.

writing.evidence: Only the 4 placement translations so far (40 words): meaning clear in 3 of 4, about 60 errors per 100 words, roughly half of them spelling (writes by ear). Needs a real writing sample.

grammar.evidence: Placement 2026-11-08, raw: A1 6/11 (55%), A2 4/11 (36%), B1 2/11 (18%), B2 1/11. Counting 5 spelling-only errors as grammar-correct: A1 8/11 (73%), A2 4/11, B1 5/11 (45%). Below the 75% bar even at A1, so no level recorded yet. Patchy profile: some B1 structures known (чтобы + past, prefixed motion verbs, -ами), basic singular endings and agreement not yet reliable.

vocabulary.evidence: Active everyday vocabulary looks solid in the translations (сестра, работать, кино, друг, фильм, помощь, найти работу); not measured yet.

weak_points.label: Writes by ear: unstressed о→а, е→и, ё→о, missing ь (-шь, фильм), ы/и, не + verb joined
Genitive after нет / много, and for people in the plural
Dative: кому? (писать, звонить, помогать) and after благодаря
Agreement with the subject: past tense gender, мне понравился / понравилась
Instrumental after с; prepositional of -ия nouns and city names
Aspect: process vs one result (past), когда + perfective future

strengths: Understands a lot and has a useful active vocabulary for everyday topics
Already uses key patterns: мне нравится, у неё (есть), с + instrumental, чтобы + past
Attempts complex sentences (который, если) instead of avoiding them

plan.next_session: Placement, part 2: a short writing sample in chat (w-a2-01 'Last weekend', 60–80 words, no translator), then a 5–10 minute speaking sample in voice mode, and the A2 reading 'Выходные без телефона' in the app. Then set first levels. First lessons after that: the Spelling sheet and test, genitive after нет / много, dative (кому?).

milestones.goal: Retake the placement test: A1 items at 85%+ and A2 items at 75%+

history.summary: Russian Coach set up: app, starter deck, grammar sheets, tests and readings. No assessment yet.

Placement part 1 (grammar test): 13/44 objective (30%); A1 6/11, A2 4/11, B1 2/11, B2 1/11. Five errors were spelling-only, so the adjusted scores are A1 73%, B1 45%. Translations: meaning clear in 3 of 4, about 60 errors per 100 words, half of them spelling.
